issue.title: Durable feature-flag controls in the SASE Admin Center
issue.description: Users can inspect and persistently enable or disable every registered SASE feature flag from either a polished Config > Flags pane or the sase flag CLI, with both surfaces sharing one crash-safe state mutation path and applying changes through the established ACE and AXE restart flows without editing normal configuration files.

issue.title: Rust feature-flag preference store and bindings
issue.description: core: add a versioned, locked, atomic machine-state store for persistent feature-flag booleans in sase-core, expose strict PyO3 read and set bindings, and prove concurrency, corruption, downgrade, and durability behavior.

issue.title: Adopt the released core binding floor
issue.description: floor: wait for the core release, raise sase's sase-core-rs dependency floor, refresh the lockfile and editable install, and smoke-test the published bindings before Python callers land.

issue.title: Shared Python resolution and mutation facade
issue.description: runtime: add the thin typed Python adapter, insert saved machine preferences into feature-flag resolution at the designed precedence, synchronize process transport after writes, and return one structured mutation outcome used by every frontend.

issue.title: Persistent flag enable and disable commands
issue.description: cli: add sorted sase flag disable and enable commands with rich and JSON results, completion, idempotent shared mutations, and the existing AXE restart machinery, including clear partial-success reporting.

issue.title: Beautiful Config Flags pane and controlled restart flow
issue.description: tui: create the default-on sunset rollout flag and its live call site, add the lazy Config > Flags list/detail pane with filtering, provenance, removal metadata, confirmation and narrow layouts, and apply successful toggles through the existing proc-aware ACE plus AXE restart path.

issue.title: Integrated documentation, visual coverage, and release verification
issue.description: polish: align all user documentation and help, exercise the complete CLI and TUI journeys including both rollout-flag states and restart failures, refresh intentional PNG goldens, and run the repository's exhaustive landing gates.

payload.entry: Landed in sase-core c04a2192392cd0226baa68d83db17f2e148be9b2 (feat(core): add versioned feature-flag preference store) on master; bindings are feature_flag_state_get / feature_flag_state_set / feature_flag_state_wire_schema_version.

Verified in sase-core: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace via just check. Store covers missing/corrupt/oversized/unsupported state without deletion, exclusive-lock RMW so concurrent writers keep distinct keys, pretty JSON atomic replace with temp cleanup, snake_case validation, unknown-key preservation, and PyO3 get/set JSON wire round trips. Commit c04a2192392cd0226baa68d83db17f2e148be9b2 is on sase-core master. No leftover --epic-symbol entries.
